# makefun-token-radar

[![make.fun · token-radar-01](https://make.fun/badge/token-radar-01.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/token-radar-01?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=token-radar-01)

[![reward](https://make.fun/badge/token-radar-01/mikasaggwp/makefun-token-radar/reward.svg)](https://make.fun/bounty/token-radar-01?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=token-radar-01)

Entry for the [Build the best token launch radar bounty](https://make.fun/bounty/token-radar-01) on make.fun.

A dashboard ranking every pre-token protocol in the sealed DefiLlama snapshot (as of 2026-11-14) by implied launch value — 198 rows: the whole 40-protocol watchlist plus 158 rankable pre-token protocols below the $50M floor. Protocols whose token already trades are kept apart in the Live view at the market's own value.

## Run it

```sh
mkdir -p out && MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts --input <snapshot.json|directory>
```
